title: Area of a triangle: why it is half base times height
examples: Why is the area of a triangle half base times height?
What is the area of a triangle with base 10 and height 7?

explain.say: Here is a rectangle of dots: 4 rows of 6. Its area is 6 times 4, which is 24 squares. Now imagine cutting it from one corner to the opposite corner with scissors.

draw.text: Area of a triangle: why it is half base times height

explain.say: The cut makes two triangles that are exactly the same. Put one on top of the other and they match. So each triangle is one half of the rectangle. See the bar split into halves?
Half of 24 is 12. So the triangle covers 12 squares. Look: 4 rows of 3 is 12, the same amount as one triangle. Can you see the rule coming?
The rule is: area equals half of base times height. The base is the bottom side, 6. The height must go straight up from the base, at a right angle, not along a slanted side. Here it is 4.

faq.q: What is the base of a triangle?
faq.a: Any side can be the base. It is the side you measure the height from, usually the bottom side.
It is the straight-up distance from the base to the opposite corner, meeting the base at a right angle. It is not the slanted side.
asks: What height do I use for a triangle?

faq.q: Why is a triangle half a rectangle?
faq.a: Draw a rectangle around the triangle using its base and height. The triangle fills exactly half of it, so its area is half of base times height.
asks: Why divide by 2 for a triangle?

faq.q: Does the formula work for every triangle?
faq.a: Yes, for every triangle, as long as you use the perpendicular height, even when it falls outside the triangle.
asks: Does half base times height work for all triangles?

faq.q: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 and height 7?
faq.a: Half of 10 times 7 is half of 70, which is 35 square centimetres.
asks: Area of a triangle base 10 height 7

facts: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × perpendicular height.
Two identical triangles can always be joined to make a parallelogram.

quiz.say: A triangle has a base of 8 centimetres and a height of 5 centimetres. What is its area?
quiz.why: Half of 8 times 5 is half of 40, which is 20.

quiz.say: Which length should you use as the height of a triangle?
quiz.why: The height must meet the base at a right angle.

wrong.1: A slanted side is longer than the true height.
wrong.2: Only the perpendicular distance gives the right area.
